question: Does the Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial model comparison maintain valid null centering (C1: null median < 0) and detection sensitivity (C3: p < 0.001) on real TodoMVC hash-SPA transitions at URL-level, where state representation is fragment-aware (not synthetic state_id) and transitions are genuine browser interactions?
hypothesis: The Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial model comparison with K=12 passes both C1 (null median < 0 nats) and C3 (permutation p < 0.001) on at least 2/5 TodoMVC hash-SPA variants using URL-level state representation with fragment-aware normalization. This would establish the first validated estimator on genuine browser-derived transitions, bridging the synthetic→real gap that has blocked C-WEB-DYNAMICS for 30+ experiments.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if ANY of: (1) ALL 5 TodoMVC variants fail either C1 (null median >= 0 nats) or C3 (permutation p >= 0.001); OR (2) fewer than 2/5 variants achieve >=50 non-leakage transitions; OR (3) positive control (synthetic 12-state SPA) fails C1 or C3 (confirming estimator implementation is broken); OR (4) measurement validity fails (e.g., Playwright collection infrastructure failures on all variants).
baselines: URL-only PMI baseline: compute I(url_after; action | url_before) without history conditioning. Expected >0 on TodoMVC (parent EXP-PHYSICS-35262258744 found 0.188-0.209 bits). Provides within-experiment comparison showing what state-conditioned Bayesian analysis adds beyond unconditional PMI.

Action-history prediction accuracy at K=3: fraction of transitions where (url_before, H_K=3) determines url_after. Expected ~1.0 on deterministic TodoMVC FSMs (parent EXP-PHYSICS-35290611436 found 1.0 on 4/5 variants). Provides environment characterization.

State-history K=2 PMI baseline: compute I(url_after; url_before, H_K=2) using plug-in estimator. Expected >0 on TodoMVC (parent EXP-PHYSICS-35375596894 found 0.933 bits on synthetic 12-state SPA). Provides comparison for Bayesian advantage.
positive_control: Synthetic 12-state stochastic hash-routed SPA with N=5000, seed=42. Known to pass C1+C3 with Bayesian DM (EXP-PHYSICS-35578258358: null median -78 to -131 nats, p=0.0005). Pass criterion: C1 (null median < 0) AND C3 (p < 0.001) on all 3 alpha_prior values {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}. This validates the estimator implementation before testing on real data.
null_control: Within-session shuffled-action permutation (same framework as parent). For each session, shuffle the action labels while preserving the session trajectory order. Compute log BF on shuffled data. Null distribution built from N_SHUFFLE=1999 permutations. Pass criterion: null median < 0 nats (C1). This is the same null framework that passed on synthetic SPA.
measurement_validity: Playwright browser-based collection on 5 TodoMVC hash-SPA variants: vanilla JS (ES6), React, Vue, Angular, Svelte. URLs: todomvc.com/examples/{vanillajs,react,vue,angular,svelte}/

URL-level state representation with fragment-aware normalization: strip trailing slash, decode percent-encoding, preserve fragment (e.g., #/active, #/completed are distinct states). Same normalization as parent EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569.
Minimum 50 non-leakage transitions per variant. From EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569: all 5 variants have achievable NL 357-394 at 500 raw (leakage 21-28%), so 50 NL requires ~70 raw transitions.

Leakage definition: action.target_href == state_after.url (same as parent). Link-click transitions have 100% leakage by design; non-link transitions (button_click, form_submit, js_navigate) have 0% leakage.
At least 5 distinct browsing sessions per variant (different starting points, action sequences).
No authentication required (TodoMVC is publicly accessible).
K=12 Dirichlet-Multinomial with alpha_prior in {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}. State-history K2 = (url_before + 2 previous URLs). Same model specification as parent EXP-PHYSICS-35578258358.
N=5000 transitions per variant (matching parent sample size). If collection yields fewer, report actual N and note in validity_notes.
decision_rule: ALL of the following must hold for SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST: (C1) null median < 0 nats on >=2/5 variants; (C3) permutation p < 0.001 on >=2/5 variants; (C5) >=50 non-leakage transitions on >=2/5 variants; (C6) positive control passes (C1+C3 on synthetic SPA); (C7) no measurement validity violations. If C6 fails (positive control broken) → MEASUREMENT_INVALID. If C1 or C3 fails on all 5 variants → FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING. If C5 fails (insufficient data on all variants) → MEASUREMENT_INVALID. If some variants pass and others fail → MIXED with bounded claim ceiling to passing variants only.
product_consequence_positive: The Bayesian DM estimator is validated on genuine browser-derived TodoMVC hash-SPA transitions, establishing the first production-relevant estimator for C-WEB-DYNAMICS. This opens the path to testing on production SPAs with richer state variation (title changes, form-heavy flows, stochastic transitions). The synthetic→real gap is bridged for URL-level state representation.
product_consequence_negative: The Bayesian DM fails on real browser transitions despite passing on synthetic SPA. The synthetic→real gap is identified as the binding bottleneck. The Physics lane should consider: (a) continuous-state estimators (KDE/kNN on embeddings) that don't require discrete state binning, (b) richer state representations (DOM, accessibility tree, visual layout), or (c) abandoning URL-level PMI for production SPAs.
estimated_cost: Medium: 5 TodoMVC variants × ~70 raw transitions each = ~350 raw transitions total. Playwright browser collection (~2-3 hours including setup). Bayesian analysis with N_SHUFFLE=1999 permutations (~1-2 hours compute). Total estimated 4-5 hours.
expected_information_gain: Very high: this is the single highest-value experiment for C-WEB-DYNAMICS. It directly addresses the synthetic→real gap that has been the dominant bottleneck across 30+ experiments. A positive result (>=2/5 variants pass C1+C3) establishes the estimator on real data and opens production SPA testing. A negative result (all variants fail) identifies the binding limitation and forces a strategic pivot in state representation or estimation approach. Either outcome resolves the dominant unknown.
